note: Which group of docs/audio/voicing-groups.json (and the shell lines, group ui) is in which part of a narrator's voice. One voice pack may hold at most 64 MiB (ZipLimits.maxTotalBytes), and a whole narrator is about 92 MiB, so the voice is several packs: part 1 is voice-<id>, part N is voice-<id>-N (N from 2 to 9). Whole groups, in manifest order, fixed here so that a rebuild never moves a group because a clip changed its size. Measured on hero-son 2.0.0 (2026-11-08): part 1 about 52.7 MiB (82% of the limit), part 2 about 39.1 MiB. voice_gen refuses a part over the limit before it is signed, and warns above 90%. Change the split only here, by hand, together with the app's installed parts (a group that moves leaves a part that must be built again).
